# Tamarind Valley Collective

> Not just a farm — a regenerative ecosystem: 98 acres of the Melagiri Hills near Kanakapura, regenerated by 53 member families since 2017 through permaculture and reforestation.

TVC sits on the Tamil Nadu–Karnataka border, inside the Melagiri Hills' elephant corridor (part of the same connected landscape as the Cauvery North Wildlife Sanctuary, Bannerghatta, and the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve). It's a members-owned collective, not a resort or a business — it hosts day visits, overnight camps, workshops, and retreats, and documents its regeneration work publicly. Kannada (`/kn/`) and Tamil (`/ta/`) translations exist for most pages linked below.

## Visit

- [Plan a visit](https://tvc.farm/visit): Day trips, overnight camps, workshops, and volunteering — what to expect, activities, and how to plan a visit.
- [Overnight camping](https://tvc.farm/visit/camping): A two-day overnight camp — arrival, a hike to the sunset viewpoint, campfire, and a guided farm tour the next morning.
- [Day visit](https://tvc.farm/visit/day-visit): Three ways to spend a day — a relaxed picnic, a hiking adventure, or doing absolutely nothing.
- [Host an event](https://tvc.farm/visit/host-an-event): Hosting workshops, retreats, and gatherings at TVC.
- [How to reach](https://tvc.farm/visit/how-to-reach): Directions from the Tamil Nadu and Karnataka sides, plus history of the surrounding forest.
- [Trekking trails](https://tvc.farm/visit/trekking-trails): Three trails into the adjacent forest — the Temple Trail, the Watering Hole Trail, and the Top of the Hill Trail.

## Events

- [Events](https://tvc.farm/events): Upcoming and past events — camps, workshops, biodiversity walks, and retreats.

## The ecosystem

- [Ecosystem overview](https://tvc.farm/ecosystem): How the 98 acres work as one ecosystem — a wildlife corridor, food forest, and farmland regenerating together.
- [Biodiversity](https://tvc.farm/ecosystem/biodiversity): Live biodiversity sightings and birds recorded at TVC, sourced from iNaturalist.
- [Landscape](https://tvc.farm/ecosystem/landscape): TVC's physical setting in the Melagiri Hills and its place in the wider wildlife corridor.
- [Weather](https://tvc.farm/ecosystem/weather): Live weather at TVC, and the rainfall and monsoon patterns that shape the seasons.

## About

- [About](https://tvc.farm/about): Why Tamarind Valley Collective exists, what it stands for, and how the land is laid out.
- [Design](https://tvc.farm/about/design): How TVC's land is laid out — the wildlife corridor, food forests, cultivated zones, and water works — plus a drone flyover.
- [Our Journey](https://tvc.farm/our-journey): From 98 degraded acres to a regenerating ecosystem, walked year by year in photos.
- [In Pictures](https://tvc.farm/in-pictures): Photos of the land, the community, and daily life at TVC, from 2017 to today.

## People

- [People](https://tvc.farm/people): The 53 member families, the local staff who run things day to day, TVC's partners, and its work with the neighboring community.
- [Staff](https://tvc.farm/people/staff): The small, dedicated team who run TVC day to day, living on-site.
- [Members](https://tvc.farm/people/members): The 53 member families who make up Tamarind Valley Collective.
- [Partners](https://tvc.farm/people/partners): TVC's partners — conservation, land design, architecture, foraging, hospitality, and the real estate partner who helped found TVC.
- [Community outreach](https://tvc.farm/people/outreach): Work TVC has done with the local community around it, in Odhipuram and Thaggatti village.

## Other

- [Join Us](https://tvc.farm/join): How membership in the collective actually works — TVC doesn't offer a financial return, it offers a different one.
- [Resource Centre](https://tvc.farm/resource-centre): Lantana furniture and learning programs from Tamarind Valley Collective.
- [Contact](https://tvc.farm/contact): Get in touch with Tamarind Valley Collective — the Friends of TVC WhatsApp group and general enquiries.
